conviction_note: Nothing found that the market cannot see. The evidence leans slightly positive: the company's own Q2 EBITDA range, with interest on the $27m of June ATM proceeds added, implies EPS of about $0.16-0.185 against a disputed $0.13-0.16 consensus; GE's customer-supplied FY27 total implies an H2 ramp; and PAC-3 demand news has arrived since the last call. Against that, fabric sales are back in the mix and the finance function has turned over. Scale is 8.0% (the indicative straddle is 7.89% on a 47% spread; the historical median is 7.35%; a new Q3 projection is coming). p_up is 55, so the scaled number is +0.8 against an impact_sum of +1.3. The two agree in sign; the sum is larger because several small positive proxies stack.
bar: Revenue: company Q2 FY27 projection of $19.5-21.0m sales and $4.3-5.1m adjusted EBITDA, with GE engine-program sales of $7.5-8.25m, given on the 2026-07-20 call (transcript https://www.webull.com/news/15261981797278720; https://www.stocktaper.com/earningsCallSummary/PKE/2027/Q1). Revenue consensus is $19.54m per Chartmill (https://www.chartmill.com/news/PKE/Chartmill-51213-Park-Aerospace-Corp-NYSEPKE-Surges-After-Strong-Earnings-Beat) and $20.0m per Benzinga (https://www.benzinga.com/quote/PKE/earnings-forecasts), both inside the guide. The EPS consensus is DISPUTED: $0.13 (Chartmill) against $0.16 (Benzinga). Findings that rest on EPS are capped small. Park landed at the top of its Q1 ranges ($18.31m against 17.7-18.4; EBITDA $4.58m against 4.1-4.6) and inside its Q4 range ($24.19m against 23.5-24.5). print_vs_bar assumes about $20.6m against $20.0m.
positioning_check: Short interest is about 1.1m shares, 4.34 days to cover, at the 2026-07-15 FINRA settlement (https://curvedtrading.com/stocks/pke/short-interest/), with 1.3m and 2.2 days at 06-30. Equibles shows 1.2m, 5.6% of float and 3.4 days, settlement undated, about August 2026 (https://equibles.com/stocks/pke/shortinterest). No September settlement found. That is moderate, not crowded, but up roughly 3x on the ~340k of September 2025. The 25-delta skew is null and the chain is unusable: total OI 102, put/call OI 1.32, ATM spread 47% of mid. The option market therefore makes no directional statement. Tape: spot $30.09, -2.0% over 20 days, +1.2% over 5 days, -21% from the 52-week high. The fall is mostly the slide from a $38.20 close on 2026-08-14 to about $30 by mid-September (https://stockanalysis.com/stocks/pke/history/), with no company news found to explain it.

findings.finding: Park's own Q2 adjusted-EBITDA range ($4.3-5.1m) implies GAAP EPS of about $0.16-0.185, against a consensus of $0.13 (Chartmill) or $0.16 (Benzinga). The calculation takes off Q1 depreciation of $469k and stock-option expense of $92k, adds interest and other income of about $1.0m (Q1 was $786k on $89m of cash, now plus $27.2m of June ATM proceeds), and applies Q1's 26.4% tax rate over about 22.1m diluted shares (21.23m Q1 diluted plus the 870k ATM shares sold in June). So the lower consensus sits below the company's own floor.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q1 FY27 EPS $0.17 against $0.14 consensus (a 21% beat), landing at the top of its own range: +7.35% on 2026-07-20. Q4 FY26 also beat on EPS and revenue and fell -12.47% on 2026-05-28, which shows beats are not reliably bought.
findings.why_not_priced: The $0.13 Chartmill consensus looks like it has not been rebuilt for the extra interest income or for the guide. If the market held the company-implied number, both estimate sources would read about $0.17 rather than disagreeing. Coverage is two analysts. However, the beat lands INSIDE what management guided, so an attentive holder already expects it.
findings.independence: The ATM completion and its proceeds come from the 10-Q (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0000076267/000143774926023883/pke20260708_10q.htm). The EBITDA guide comes from the call transcript (https://www.webull.com/news/15261981797278720). The calculation is my inference from those documents, not an analyst's number.

findings.finding: Q2 gross margin is exposed to the return of low-margin resold ArianeGroup C2B fabric. Q1 had zero fabric sales and a 34.8% gross margin. For Q2 management said the mix would be 'more balanced between the fabric and the prepreg', but 'not significant' to the bottom line. In Q4 FY26, about $7.2m of fabric at 'very light margins' produced a 28.7% gross margin. The company's own EBITDA guide, with Q1 SG&A of $2.36m, implies Q2 gross margin of about 31-33%, just above the 30% floor management says it dislikes breaching.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: May 2026 (Q4 FY26): revenue inside its guide, 28.7% gross margin below 30%, stock -12.47% (driver per https://tickeron.com/blogs/why-is-park-aerospace-corp-pke-stock-down-14-today-13814/). July 2026: margin recovered to 34.8%, stock +7.35%.
findings.why_not_priced: The fabric mix was disclosed on the call, and the EBITDA guide already embeds it. This is mostly priced and inside guidance. The residual risk is a headline gross margin under 30% if fabric runs heavier than guided, because the timing is set by the customer, not Park. If that were priced, the stock would not have shown the -12.5% sensitivity to this line in May.
findings.independence: The Q4 fabric amounts of about $7.2m (quarter) and $9.8m (year) come from the Q3 FY26 forecast as summarised in https://finance.yahoo.com/news/park-aerospace-q3-earnings-call-001451609.html. The Q4 gross margin is from the 8-K exhibit https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0000076267/000143774926023877/ex_990131.htm. This finding shares the call transcript with the GE/H2 finding.

findings.finding: On the July call management said GE Aerospace's customer-supplied FY27 total for Park's GE engine programs is about $34.4m, 'haircut slightly'. Q1 was $7.1m and Q2 is guided at $7.5-8.25m, so H2 needs about $19.4m, roughly $9.7m a quarter. Since that call, GE raised its 2026 guide on 2026-07-16 (LEAP deliveries +41% in H1), and Airbus deliveries ran +9% year to date through August (475 against 434). Both support a higher Q3 projection on tonight's call.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The next-quarter projection has driven the reactions. May 2026: the Q1 projection of $17.7-18.4m was a sequential drop from $24.2m, and the stock fell -12.47%. January 2026: a Q4 projection of $23.5-24.5m, and the stock rose +9.58%.
findings.why_not_priced: Mostly priced. Chartmill's FY27 consensus of $83.1m revenue already implies H2 of about $44.5m, roughly $22m a quarter, which is a ramp. The unpriced part is only whether Park's Q3 projection lands above about $22m. If the market expected that clearly, the stock would not be 21% below its August high.
findings.independence: Proxy: GE Q2 2026 release https://geaerospace.com/news/press-releases/ge-aerospace-announces-second-quarter-2026-results (2026-07-16). Airbus August deliveries: https://aerocorner.com/news/airbus-august-2026-deliveries-target/. Neither is a Park number. GE also flagged spare-parts material constraints, which cuts the other way.

findings.finding: Two counterparty contracts post-date Park's 2026-07-20 call. On 2026-07-29 Lockheed received a seven-year PAC-3 MSE multiyear action of up to $53.86bn, $58.62bn in total, to triple output by 2030. On 2026-09-09 Lockheed gave L3Harris (ex-Aerojet) a $4.7bn undefinitized subcontract for PAC-3 MSE solid rocket motors. Park says it is sole-source qualified for ablative materials in those motors and signed a 2026-07-09 letter of agreement with a large PAC-3 contractor. The call is the first chance for Park to quantify orders against these awards.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No clean prior: the July call introduced the PAC-3 letter of agreement and the ArianeGroup term sheet, and the stock rose +7.35%, but that call also carried a margin recovery.
findings.why_not_priced: The prime and subcontract awards are public. What is unpublished is any Park-level order or rate number; the July call gave none ('a little higher' than 600 a year). The stock slid from $38 to $30 after the awards, so the market has not paid for the read-through.
findings.independence: The Lockheed multiyear is reported separately at https://www.calibredefence.co.uk/lockheed-pac-3-mse-58-62bn-contract/. Park's sole-source claim comes from the call summary https://www.stocktaper.com/earningsCallSummary/PKE/2027/Q1. This is a proxy, with no Park confirmation of orders.

findings.finding: Insiders sold at prices well above today's. CEO Brian Shore exercised and sold about 156k shares at $37.09-38.17 on 2026-08-10 to 08-13, leaving his direct holding at 621,369. President/COO Mark Esquivel sold about 60k shares for about $1.99m in July. CLO (now CFO) Petropoulos exercised and sold 2.5k at $36 on 2026-07-27. The stock is now $30.09.
findings.why_not_priced: Form 4s are public and two months old. These are exercise-and-sell trades of old options ($11-14 strikes), the usual diversification pattern. This is information about insiders' view of the price at $37-38, not about the quarter.
findings.independence: Form 4 list: https://www.sec.gov/cgi-bin/browse-edgar?action=getcompany&CIK=0000076267&type=4&dateb=&owner=include&count=10. The Esquivel sale is from an aggregator, https://www.stockalarm.io/ (snippet_only via search).

findings.finding: The finance and operating team has turned over since the last full close. An SVP/GM was terminated without stated reason on 2026-07-07 (8-K). The company filed an NT 10-Q for Q1 on 2026-07-15. The VP/Corporate Controller died suddenly on 2026-07-21. A new CFO (Petropoulos, previously Chief Legal and Capital Markets Officer) was named 2026-08-13. This is the first quarter he closes, which raises the risk of a messy release or a late 10-Q.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: July 2026: the NT 10-Q preceded a clean Q1 print the stock bought +7.35%. A 2024 NT 10-K is also on file, with no reaction measured.
findings.why_not_priced: Each item is public. Together they are a risk-of-error flag, not a directional fact. The release date was set on schedule (2026-10-05 PR), which argues against a delay.

findings.finding: On 2026-09-24, two weeks before the print, the Compensation Committee raised President/COO Mark Esquivel's base salary from $270,000 to $400,000 (+48%), effective 2026-09-28. The 8-K was signed by the new CFO.
findings.why_not_priced: It is a quiet 8-K with no wire coverage found. It is a weak board-confidence or retention signal, and could equally reflect a widened role after the July departures.

findings.finding: The ArianeGroup term sheet of 2026-07-18 gives Park 100% of the output of a planned US C2B fabric plant, against $25m of Park advance payments in 2026-27 applied to purchases from 2030. Management said 'hundreds of millions' of revenue over 2030-36 and a definitive agreement 'before year-end'. The call could update this, including timing of the $25m cash outflow.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: First disclosed on the July call, which rose +7.35% alongside the margin recovery.
findings.why_not_priced: The term sheet is public. A definitive signing would be new, but none had been announced by 2026-10-08, and 'before year-end' may fall outside the window. Financing question asked: the $25m buys secured C2B supply for the PAC-3 ramp, a demand-backed use. Sign is neutral to positive.
findings.independence: Shares the call transcript with the GE/H2 and fabric findings. Secondary: https://www.stocktaper.com/earningsCallSummary/PKE/2027/Q1.

findings.finding: The stock fell from a $38.20 close on 2026-08-14 to about $29.3-31.3 through September and early October (-21%), on ordinary volume apart from 825k on 2026-09-18 (quarterly expiry/rebalance day). lessons_applied: Rule 6 (bar disputed, inside guide): the EPS-vs-consensus finding went from +1.0 to +0.5, because the EPS bar disagrees between sources ($0.13 vs $0.16) and the implied beat lands inside management's own EBITDA range.
Rule 6 (inside guide): the gross-margin/fabric finding went from -0.5 to -0.3, because the fabric mix was guided and is embedded in the EBITDA range.

Rule 5 (proxy): the GE/Airbus H2-ramp finding went from +1.0 to +0.6, and the PAC-3 Lockheed/L3Harris read-through from +0.8 to +0.5, because both are macro-to-company proxies with no Park order confirmation.
Rule 5 (unexplained drawdown worth about 0): the drawdown/positioning finding went from +0.3 to +0.1.

Rule 3 (own caveat): the insider-sales and finance-turnover findings went from -0.3 to -0.2 each, because each one's own text says exercise-and-sell diversification and a clean July close after the NT 10-Q.
Rule 4 (financing): the ArianeGroup $25m advance is signed as a demand-backed supply purchase (neutral to positive), unchanged at +0.2.
